description_en: Updates the name of an instance
kebab_example: aliyun alidns update-cloud-gtm-instance-name --accept-language en-US --client-token 1ae05db4-10e7-11ef-b126-00163e240022 --instance-id gtm-cn-jmp3qnw0003 --instance-name test --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateCloudGtmInstanceName

parameters.help_en:
The language in which the response is returned. Valid values:

zh-CN: Chinese

en-US: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回结果显示的语言。取值：

zh-CN：中文

en-US：英文
parameters.name: accept_language

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can customize the token value, but it must be unique across different requests and can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用户生成的请求token。用于保证请求的幂等性。该参数值可自定义，但是要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The name of the instance. This parameter cannot be left empty
parameters.help_zh: 实例名称，不可传入空值
parameters.name: instance_name

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance name update operation was successful. Valid values:

true: Successful.

false: Failed

本次修改实例名称操作是否成功：
